landmarks.name: Lake Wānaka
landmarks.fact: Lake Wānaka is New Zealand's fourth-largest lake, known for its crystal-clear glacial waters and scenic mountain backdrop.

landmarks.name: Roys Peak
landmarks.fact: Roys Peak stands at 1,578 meters altitude between Wanaka and Glendhu Bay in the South Island.

landmarks.name: Roys Peak Lookout
landmarks.fact: Roys Peak Lookout is a famous vantage point offering breathtaking 360-degree views of Lake Wānaka and surrounding peaks.
